$comment: Declarative UI (docs/plugins.md §5.3). Third-party and agent-authored plugins ship only this file and plugin.yaml: no React. Each toolbar action names a command, which runs through the command gateway; each panel names a trusted renderer (`studio.declarative-panel.v1`, `studio.sandbox-frame.v1`, `studio.mask-review.v1`). Unknown renderers fail closed. `visibleWhen` takes assetMediaType (image/* wildcards), selection, or a `when` clause. Delete what you don't need.
